title: The Hills above Clonmel
content: Happy Saint Patrick's Day, everyone!Here's a little plein air painting that I did in County Tipperary, Ireland in 2004.On that trip I didn't rent a car; I just bummed rides. I had all my painting gear in one backpack and all my other gear in a suitcase. I wandered on foot each day alone in search of a motif while my sonDanwas in town studying Irish music and prepping for theFleadh Cheoil.This day I walked up a hill road until I found a break in the hedgerow and a place with a big view. I could look way down into the valley and almost hear the fever of the jigs and reels, while the silent sea of heaven rolled overhead.
